title: Save the Pets
description: Pull pins, clear blockers, and solve clever stage contraptions to rescue puppies, kittens, and cute critters before danger strikes.
controls: Tap or slide pins and obstacles in the right sequence to guide pets safely to the exit.

zh-CN.title: 救救萌宠
zh-CN.description: 治愈系 3D 解谜救救萌宠：仔细观察机关顺序，拉动障碍化解岩浆与陷阱，把可爱的小猫小狗全部平安救出！
zh-CN.controls: 按正确顺序点击或滑动机关挡板，化解危险把小动物们安全送到终点。
